parameters.query: WITH accepted AS (INSERT INTO webhook_events (provider, provider_event_id, event_type, payload_sha256, processing_status, processed_at) VALUES ('stripe', $1, $2, $3, 'processed', now()) ON CONFLICT (provider, provider_event_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING provider_event_id) INSERT INTO recovery_cases (provider_payment_intent_id, provider_customer_id, customer_email, amount_minor, currency, failure_category, provider_failure_code, status, attempts_completed, max_attempts, next_retry_at, policy_version) SELECT $4, $5, $6, $7, upper($8), $9, $10, $11, $12, $13, $14::timestamptz, $15 FROM accepted WHERE $16::boolean ON CONFLICT (provider, provider_payment_intent_id) DO UPDATE SET failure_category = EXCLUDED.failure_category, provider_failure_code = EXCLUDED.provider_failure_code, status = EXCLUDED.status, attempts_completed = EXCLUDED.attempts_completed, max_attempts = EXCLUDED.max_attempts, next_retry_at = EXCLUDED.next_retry_at, policy_version = EXCLUDED.policy_version, version = recovery_cases.version + 1, updated_at = now() RETURNING id

WITH accepted AS (INSERT INTO webhook_events (provider, provider_event_id, event_type, payload_sha256, processing_status, processed_at) VALUES ('stripe', $1, $2, $3, 'processed', now()) ON CONFLICT (provider, provider_event_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING provider_event_id) UPDATE recovery_cases SET status = CASE WHEN $2 = 'payment_succeeded' THEN 'recovered' ELSE 'cancelled' END, next_retry_at = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, recovered_at = CASE WHEN $2 = 'payment_succeeded' THEN now() ELSE NULL END, cancelled_at = CASE WHEN $2 = 'payment_canceled' THEN now() ELSE NULL END, version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE provider = 'stripe' AND provider_payment_intent_id = $4 AND status NOT IN ('recovered', 'cancelled') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accepted) RETURNING id

meta.policyBoundary: Classification and retry policy are supplied by payment_recovery, never calculated in this workflow
